prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-87479
prose.body:
Hi there,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge from the team at Elmstead Freight regarding invoice INV-87479.

We noticed that the payment of 4,088.69 USDC hasn’t cleared yet. No worries at all, these things happen! We just wanted to make sure everything was on track on our end.

To settle this, please direct the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xdf5ad2c24a60d63d7af3cfbb071c9711273dd04c.

If you’ve already sent this, please disregard this note or let us know if there are any issues with the transfer. If you have any questions about the invoice or need a copy resent, just hit reply.

Thanks so much for your business and for helping us keep the logistics moving smoothly!

Best regards,

The Elmstead Freight Team
